mutants.why: saveRejectsOversizedPayload requires the write side to enforce the same cap as the reader before creating a snapshot that cannot be loaded.
saveReportsDirectoryCreationFailure pins the direct mkdir failure and its exact path instead of accepting a later indirect QSaveFile error.
boundedReadRejectsGrowthBeyondCap passes a max+1 sequential payload through the test seam and requires refusal after the bounded read.
boundedReadRejectsErrorAfterValidPrefix supplies valid JSON followed by a synthetic device failure and requires the exact read error.
loadRejectsMissingSchemaVersion requires an absent version to fail instead of being read as the current schema.
loadRejectsWrongFieldType writes a numeric run_id and requires an exact string-type schema failure.
loadRejectsUnknownStatus rejects an unknown status before runStatusFromString can silently turn it into Idle.
loadRejectsNonObjectRoot requires a valid JSON array to receive the exact root-object diagnostic, not a later missing-schema error.
loadReportsJsonParseError pins a domain-specific prefix plus Qt's exact parser reason.
